decision_reason: V2.5 closure selects descriptor-only as the explicit artifact download contract. Existing V2.5 artifacts expose safe artifact descriptors with artifact:// refs and binary metadata. Direct binary streaming is not implemented or accepted in V2.5 unless a later product/API decision reopens it.
open_questions: If a later version requires direct stream, what authorization and expiry semantics apply?
If a later version requires direct stream, should range requests be supported?
